resources.string: Location and study telemetry are being collected for your enrolled study.
Open StudyTrace to complete your study prompt.
I have read and agree to the study consent provided by the research team
StudyTrace is a research app that collects sensor and survey data to help scientists understand human behavior and context.

StudyTrace collects only the location, survey responses, app-usage metadata, and device state described by your study after you consent. It never records the content you view or type in other apps. Data is stored on your device first and synced securely to your research team’s server.

Research teams configure approved sensors and surveys on their server, then invite participants with a secure URL. StudyTrace does not collect contacts or phone numbers and contains no advertising SDK.

By participating, you agree to the research data collection described by your study team. A study may request location samples, survey responses, app foreground-use duration, launch counts, screen lock or unlock events, and device state.

StudyTrace collects only enabled data streams after consent. Your data is stored on your device first and sent only to the configured research server—not for advertising or cross-app tracking.

You may review permissions or withdraw at any time. You will also review your study team’s study-specific consent before enrollment.

Please confirm that you understand and consent to participate.
If you decline, StudyTrace will not collect study data. You can change your mind later by reopening onboarding.
StudyTrace needs location access only when your study includes mobility or context sensing. Background collection starts only after enrollment and remains visible through an Android notification.
When enabled by your study, StudyTrace can measure app labels, foreground-use duration, launch counts, and screen lock or unlock events. It cannot read the content you view or type.
StudyTrace uses notifications for survey reminders, study updates, and the required indicator while background location collection is active.
You’re ready to review your study invitation. No study data is collected until you join an approved study and grant its requested permissions.
Review and accept the upfront consent information before joining a study.

StudyTrace collects precise or approximate location data to enable research mobility and context sensing even when the app is closed or not in use. Location data is sent to the secure research server configured for your study and is available to the research team under your study consent. You can stop collection in StudyTrace or revoke location access in Android Settings at any time.

StudyTrace collects app package names, app labels, foreground-use time, launch counts, and screen lock or unlock events to support the research study, including when StudyTrace is not open. This data is sent to the secure research server configured for your study and is available to the research team under your study consent. StudyTrace does not collect the content you view or type in other apps.
